recs.heading: Compass Recommends

overdue.why: Overdue invoices hold back cash and get harder to collect the longer they wait.
overdue.next: Prepare personalised payment reminders for the {{families}} eligible families and approve them in Payments.
overdue.explain: Compass read every unpaid invoice from Xero and checked it against your payment rules. {{over}} invoices are more than {{days}} days overdue. {{held}} families are held back because of an agreed extension, a dispute, their enrolment or your minimum rules.
overdue.impact_one: Up to {{amount}} could come in from {{count}} family
overdue.impact_other: Up to {{amount}} could come in from {{count}} families

enquiries.why: Families who wait more than a day for a reply are more likely to look elsewhere.
enquiries.next: Answer the oldest enquiries first. {{red}} have waited more than {{hours}} hours.
enquiries.explain: Compass counted every email and text from a parent or new family that has no reply yet. The oldest has waited {{oldest}} hours.

decisions.why: Admins can't finish these until you decide, and the family is waiting too.
decisions.next: Open Approval Alley and review the oldest request first.
decisions.explain: These requests are marked Owner Review Required or Waiting for Owner. {{welfare}} involve a welfare concern, which only you should handle.

cover.why: A lesson without a tutor means a disappointed family and a likely refund.
cover.next: Start the Tutor Absence workflow to find cover with the right subject and free time.
cover.explain: These lessons fall on days when {{tutor}} is recorded as away. The first one starts in {{hours}} hours.

tutor_message.title: Check {{tutor}}'s message about being away
tutor_message.why: A tutor said they may miss lessons, but no absence is recorded yet, so nobody is finding cover.
tutor_message.next: Record the absence with the Tutor Absence workflow. Compass will find the affected lessons and suggest cover.
tutor_message.explain: Compass found {{count}} unanswered message from a tutor about an absence.

lesson_changes.why: Lesson changes left open can clash with other bookings and confuse families.
lesson_changes.next: Start the Lesson Change workflow for each message. It checks the tutor's free times and your rules.
lesson_changes.explain: {{messages}} parent messages ask to move a lesson and {{requests}} saved lesson changes are still open.

retention.title_one: Check in with {{count}} student showing signs of leaving
retention.title_other: Check in with {{count}} students showing signs of leaving
retention.why: Missed lessons and concerns are early signs a family may stop.
retention.next: Open Student Retention to review the findings and prepare a check-in.
retention.explain: The Student Retention Agent flagged {{high}} high and {{medium}} medium of {{monitored}} students. These are prompts, not predictions.

failed_texts.why: The family didn't get the message, so they may miss a lesson.
failed_texts.next: Check the phone number for {{name}} and send the reminder again.
failed_texts.explain: The SMS provider reported that this text failed.

all_clear.title: Nothing Urgent This Week
all_clear.why: Everything Compass checked is on track.
all_clear.next: Have a quick look at What Needs My Attention? for anything new.
all_clear.explain: No overdue invoices, waiting enquiries, cover gaps or owner decisions passed your thresholds.
